instruction:
Three Storey Dormitory IFC And Revit Plan/Section Sheet PDF

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a three-storey dormitory building, export the model as result.ifc, and export a two-page Revit sheet PDF with a typical plan and section as result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.pdf; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 18 IfcSpace entities, 12 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcRoof, 15 IfcDoor entities, 15 IfcWindow entities, and 3 IfcStair entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token corridor at least 3 times, bedroom at least 12 times, and bathroom at least 3 times.
7. result.pdf contains exactly 2 pages exported from Revit sheets.
8. The extracted text from result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 TYPICAL FLOOR PLAN, A301 SECTION, Level 3, Level 2, and Level 1.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
